# Workplace Violence Prevention & Active Shooter Training

> Workplace Violence Prevention & Active Shooter Training: 3 self-paced online courses from $29.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA Workplace Violence Prevention Training](https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-549): $29.99 per person, 1 hour, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with the OSHA General Duty Clause Section 5(a)(1). Enroll: https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=549. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-workplace-violence-prevention-training
- [Cal/OSHA Workplace Violence Prevention Plan Training](https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-672): $39.99 per person, 2 hours, English, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with California Labor Code Section 6401.9 (SB 553), Section 6401.7, and Title 8, California Code of Regulations Section 3203. Enroll: https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=672. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/cal-osha-workplace-violence-prevention-plan-training
- [Cal/OSHA Active Shooter and Workplace Violence Awareness Training](https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-681): $49.99 per person, 1 hour, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Title 8, California Code of Regulations Section 6401.9 (SB 553). Enroll: https://workplace-violence.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=681. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/calosha-active-shooter-workplace-violence-awareness-training
